app.no_project: The project manifest could not be loaded:
setup.shortcuts_help: They fill in the form; nothing starts until you press “Run”.
setup.preset_quick_help: One {T:instance}, one {T:seed}, a tenth of the budget, no tuning
setup.preset_saved_help: Back to the file as it is saved
setup.preset_applied: Form filled in; review it and press Run
setup.new_file: New experiment: the setup will be created at {path} when you save or run it.
setup.unreadable:
{path} could not be read, so the form starts from the defaults:
{problem}
setup.output_dir_help: Where the runs, the logs and the analysis are written; relative to the setup file. Finished runs found there are never repeated.
setup.tuning_on_help: Before the runs, irace searches the parameters left empty below. It takes a while; a paused tuning resumes where it stopped.
setup.tuning_off_help: Off: the runs use the parameter values below (or the project defaults).
setup.tuner_missing: Tuning needs R and the irace package, which were not found.
setup.matrix_help: Each {T:algorithm} × {T:variant} combination is compared on its own. Click a row or column name to toggle it all.
setup.time_limit_help: Passed as {time_limit_s}; the program should stop by itself.
setup.parallel_help: This computer has {n} cores. Off: one run at a time.
setup.kill_grace_help: A run still alive this long after its time limit is killed and recorded as failed.
setup.min_disk_help: The experiment pauses when the output disk has less free space.
setup.nothing: Nothing to run: choose at least one {T:instance} and one {T:variant}
setup.locked_running: The experiment is running: pause it to change its setup.
param.help: An empty cell uses the project default. A {T:variant} column wins over the general one.
param.help_tuning: With tuning on, an empty cell is tuned; a value fixes the {T:parameter}, so it is not tuned. A {T:variant} column wins over the general one.
param.tuning_note: When tuning ends, the values found replace the empty cells for the selected {T:variants}.
param.name: {Tc:parameter}
tuning.title: Tuning
tuning.experiments_help: irace's maxExperiments: runs it may spend tuning each {T:algorithm} {T:variant}.
tuning.calibration_help: Runs of the default configuration per {T:variant}, to find the bounds not given below.
tuning.instances_help: By default, the {T:instances} of the experiment.
tuning.own_budget: Own budget for the tuning runs
tuning.own_budget_help: Off: the tuning runs use the experiment's budget.
tuning.bounds_help: Fixed [min, max] of each {T:objective} for the tuning cost (hypervolume); a row left incomplete is calibrated.
an_setup.title: Analysis settings
an_setup.default_so: Default: best value, plus the gap when every {T:instance} has a known optimum.
an_setup.offset_help: After min-max normalization, the hypervolume reference point is 1 + offset in every {T:objective}.
an_setup.blocks_help: What the tests compare the {T:variants} on.
an_setup.aggregation_help: How the runs of an {T:instance} are combined when the blocks are {T:instances}.
confirm.title: Start the experiment?
confirm.will_save: The setup will be saved first (the previous file is kept as .bak).
confirm.resume_note: Runs already finished in the output folder are kept and not repeated.
run.none_help: Configure the experiment in step 1 and press Run. Finished runs are never repeated.
run.retry_help: Runs that ended with an error are run again
run.again_help: Runs only what is missing (or failed, if chosen), then analyses
run.pause_toast: Pause requested: the runs in progress stop and are redone on resume
run.processes: running now / at the same time
run.estimate_note: The estimate counts only the runs, not the tuning.
run.resume_note: On resume, finished runs are kept and the runs that were in progress start over. A paused tuning resumes from its last saved state.
run.analysing_note: The runs are finished. The indicators, statistical tests, tables and figures are being computed; they appear in step 3.
run.interrupted_alert: The experiment's process (pid {pid}) is gone without recording a pause or the end. See the log under “Details”; you can resume it.
run.failed_alert: The experiment stopped because of an error; the message above and the log under “Details” say why.
run.exit_code: The last run command ended with exit code {code}; see ui_run.log under “Details”.
run.no_grid: The progress appears here once a valid setup is saved.
run.matrix_help: Finished / planned. Failed runs in red. Refreshed every few seconds.
project.title: Project
project.name: name
an.none_help: It runs by itself when every run is finished; “Analyse now” analyses the runs finished so far.
an.wait_runs: The analysis appears here when the runs are finished.
an.failed_toast: The analysis failed (exit code {code}); see ui_analyze.log in the run details
an.no_figures: This analysis has no figures (it was run without them). The statistical tests are below; press “Analyse now” with figures to draw them.
an.test_note: α = {alpha}; {better}; runs aggregated by {aggregation}. Rank 1 is the best.
an.wilcoxon: Wilcoxon signed-rank with Holm's correction (significant pairs highlighted)
an.table_help: Mean (standard deviation) per {T:instance}; the best in bold.
an.times_help: Wall time reported by each run; with runs in parallel the experiment takes less than the total.
an.reference_text: from {runs} runs; reference set of {size} points
chart_help.cd: Mean ranks over the blocks; {T:variants} joined by a bar are not significantly different (Nemenyi).
chart_help.box: Indicator value of every run of each {T:variant} on this {T:instance}.
chart_help.ecdf: Share of the runs that reached each quality.
chart_help.attainment: The fronts every {T:variant} reached on this {T:instance}, over its runs.
chart_help.convergence: Best value found as the evaluations go by.
err.not_saved_invalid: Not saved: the setup has problems.
err.not_saved_running: Not saved: the experiment is running; pause it first.
err.already_running: The experiment (or its analysis) is already running.
msg.paused: paused on request: {finished} of {total} runs finished
msg.paused_tuning: paused on request during the tuning
msg.paused_ctrl_c: paused by Ctrl+C: {finished} of {total} runs finished
msg.paused_ctrl_c_tuning: paused by Ctrl+C during the tuning
msg.disk_full: only {free} GB free on the output disk (minimum {minimum} GB)
msg.tuning_skipped: every parameter is fixed in the setup
msg.tuning_unit_paused: tuning of {unit} paused; it resumes on the next run
msg.one_instance_blocks: only one instance: each (instance, seed) pair is a block
msg.blocks_dropped: {dropped} of {total} blocks dropped: some variant has no value (run missing, failed or without feasible solutions)
msg.too_few_for_tests: at least 2 variants and 2 complete blocks are needed for the tests
msg.few_blocks: only {n} blocks: the tests have little power (Demšar recommends more than 10)
msg.runs_missing: {missing} of {planned} planned runs have no result yet
msg.runs_failed: {failed} runs ended with an error and are left out
msg.figures_capped: per-instance figures only for the first {n} instances
msg.indicators_unavailable: the indicators {wrong} are not available for this project; choose from {allowed}
msg.gap_needs_optimum: the gap needs a known optimum, missing for {missing}
msg.bounds_single_objective: normalization bounds are only used by multi-objective projects
msg.bounds_not_training: bounds of “{instance}”, which is not a training instance ({known})
msg.bounds_count: bounds of {instance}: one [min, max] per objective ({expected}), got {got}
msg.bounds_order: bounds of {instance}: every pair must be [min, max] with min ≤ max
msg.param_unknown_key: “{key}” is not an algorithm (or algorithm/variant) of the project
msg.budget_empty: the budget needs evaluations, a time limit, or both
msg.seeds_empty: the list of seeds is empty
msg.pydantic.string_pattern_mismatch: has characters that are not allowed
